file_insights.purpose: Django views for warehouse management operations
key_components: warehouse_list - Browse and search warehouses with pagination
warehouse_detail - View detailed warehouse info with stock statistics
warehouse_create - AJAX POST endpoint for creating warehouses
warehouse_update - AJAX PUT endpoint for updating warehouses
api_warehouses - REST API endpoint returning active warehouses as JSON

patterns_discovered.description: warehouse_list uses Q objects for multi-field search filtering across code, name, and location fields
patterns_discovered.benefit: Flexible search without exact field matching

patterns_discovered.description: Uses .annotate() with Count and Sum to calculate total_materials and total_stock_quantity at database level
warehouse_detail checks for XMLHttpRequest header to return JSON for AJAX calls or HTML for browser requests
patterns_discovered.benefit: Single endpoint serving both AJAX and traditional page requests

patterns_discovered.description: warehouse_list implements Django Paginator with 20 items per page
patterns_discovered.benefit: Scalable list handling for large datasets

patterns_discovered.description: warehouse_create and warehouse_update implement POST and PUT methods respectively with JSON responses
warehouse_update manually parses PUT request body using string split operations
patterns_discovered.benefit: Works without external form parsing libraries

patterns_discovered.description: Manager assignment wrapped in try-except to gracefully handle missing users
patterns_discovered.benefit: Optional relationship handling without validation errors

patterns_discovered.description: created_by and updated_by fields are populated with request.user
Uses select_related for foreign key access and F expressions for database-level field comparisons
patterns_discovered.benefit: Reduced query count and better performance

gotchas_discovered.description: PUT data is manually parsed by splitting on '&' and '='. This is fragile and doesn't handle URL encoding properly
gotchas_discovered.risk: Data corruption with special characters, fails with encoded values like %20 for spaces
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Use Django's QueryDict or request parsing utilities instead

gotchas_discovered.description: Generic Exception catches all errors and returns str(e), which could expose sensitive information
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Catch specific exceptions (ValidationError, IntegrityError) and provide generic user messages

gotchas_discovered.description: Only login_required decorator used, no permission checks for warehouse management operations
gotchas_discovered.risk: Any authenticated user can create/update warehouses regardless of role
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Add @permission_required or custom decorators to restrict access

gotchas_discovered.description: Paginator hardcoded to 20 items per page
gotchas_discovered.risk: Inflexible, difficult to test, user preferences not accommodated
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Make configurable via settings or request parameters

gotchas_discovered.issue: N+1 Query Risk in Recent Movements
gotchas_discovered.description: select_related for recent_movements but only fetches last 10, could still hit N+1 if not careful
gotchas_discovered.risk: Extra database queries when rendering related objects
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Verify select_related is sufficient for template usage

gotchas_discovered.description: Multi-step operations (validation + creation + audit) not wrapped in transactions
gotchas_discovered.risk: Partial updates if error occurs mid-operation

gotchas_discovered.description: Invalid manager_id is silently ignored instead of returning validation error
gotchas_discovered.risk: User thinks they assigned a manager but warehouse has none
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Return validation error if manager_id provided but user doesn't exist

gotchas_discovered.description: Converting UUID to string but consistency varies (some return str, some raw)
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Implement consistent serialization (custom encoder or serializer class)

approach_outcome.summary: Comprehensive warehouse management view layer successfully created with 5 functional endpoints

completeness.list_functionality: Complete with search, filtering, and pagination
completeness.detail_functionality: Complete with statistics and dual response modes
completeness.create_functionality: Complete with validation and AJAX support
completeness.update_functionality: Complete with data parsing and validation

approach_outcome.architecture_fit: Views follow Django conventions with proper decorators, ORM usage, and JSON response patterns. Code integrates well with existing Warehouse and MaterialStock models
approach_outcome.production_readiness: Good foundation but requires security enhancements (permissions, transaction safety) before production deployment

recommendations.title: Add Permission-Based Access Control
recommendations.description: Implement permission checks to restrict warehouse CRUD operations to authorized users

recommendations.title: Replace Manual PUT Parsing with Django Utilities
recommendations.description: warehouse_update manually parses PUT data which is error-prone and doesn't handle encoding
recommendations.implementation: Use QueryDict or django.http.QueryDict for robust data parsing

recommendations.title: Implement Specific Exception Handling
recommendations.description: Generic Exception handling in CRUD operations could expose sensitive information
recommendations.implementation: Catch ValidationError, IntegrityError specifically; log full errors server-side, return generic messages to client

recommendations.title: Use Database Transactions for CRUD Operations
recommendations.implementation: Wrap warehouse_create and warehouse_update with @transaction.atomic decorator

recommendations.title: Improve Manager Assignment Validation
recommendations.description: Invalid manager_id silently ignored instead of validating
recommendations.implementation: Return validation error if manager_id provided but user doesn't exist

recommendations.title: Make Pagination Configurable
recommendations.implementation: Add settings.WAREHOUSES_PER_PAGE configuration or allow request parameter override

recommendations.title: Implement Consistent Serialization
recommendations.description: UUID to string conversion used inconsistently across responses
recommendations.implementation: Create a WarehouseSerializer class or custom JSON encoder for consistent formatting

recommendations.title: Add Docstring Details
recommendations.description: Functions have minimal docstrings lacking parameter and response documentation
recommendations.implementation: Expand docstrings with parameters, return values, and example responses for API endpoints
